derivation: from a compound of G3844 (παρά) and perhaps a derivative of G3633 (οἴομαι);
def: apparently a state alongside of supposition, i.e. (concretely) an adage; specially, an enigmatical or fictitious illustration

occurrences.text: This parable spake Jesus unto them: but they understood not what things they were which he spake unto them.
These things have I spoken unto you in proverbs: but the time cometh, when I shall no more speak unto you in proverbs, but I shall shew you plainly of the Father.
But it is happened unto them according to the true proverb, The dog is turned to his own vomit again; and the sow that was washed to her wallowing in the mire.

source: Strong's Exhaustive Concordance (1890) and Concise Dictionaries (1894), public domain; JSON by Open Scriptures (CC BY-SA).
